title: Redundant time.Now() validity check contradicts tst.GenTime — archived receipts falsely rejected
rationale: Deleted 4 lines (now:=time.Now(); if now.Before/now.After block) from VerifyTimestampTrusted. cert.Verify(opts) at lines 342-350 with opts.CurrentTime=tst.GenTime is the RFC 3161 §2.3-correct check; the deleted block was redundant and wrong for archived receipts whose TSA cert has since expired. Updated doc comment to accurately describe the invariant.
variants_checked: rfc3161.go:VerifyTimestampTrusted — sole occurrence of time.Now() in file; VerifyTimestamp (no-pool variant) — no redundant check, clean
bypass_considered: Cert not yet valid at tst.GenTime: cert.Verify with CurrentTime:tst.GenTime already rejects this; deleted block added no additional protection
test_note: TestVerifyTimestampTrusted_AcceptsArchivedReceiptWithExpiredTSACert added with cert expired at time.Now() but valid at GenTime; uses fresh random inputs per run
review_reason: The removed block checked time.Now() against TSA cert validity, but x509.VerifyOptions{CurrentTime: tst.GenTime} on line 345 already enforces the same constraint at the correct historical reference point per RFC 3161 §2.3. The deletion removes a logically contradictory duplicate rather than weakening any real guard; EKU and chain-trust checks are untouched.
